description: data/balancing_history/<domain>.json (schema-pairing exception, same pattern as map_file.schema.json): a flat, newest-first, unbounded log of full-document snapshots for one balancing domain, appended only by the editor's explicit Save Balancing Changes action. 'snapshot' is deliberately an unconstrained object -- it is a verbatim copy of a domain document that already validated against that domain's own schema at save time, so re-validating its shape here is redundant (this file is an audit log, not gameplay balancing data, so D-12's per-property minimum/maximum/description rule does not apply to its contents).

description.description: Optional free-text note entered at save time.

id.description: Stable uuid4 identifying this history entry.

name.description: Required session name entered at save time.

snapshot.description: Full domain document as written to data/balancing/<domain>.json at save time.

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 local timestamp (YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS) of the save.

title: balancing_history
